scope: Polling cost of Symphony's customer window (648 described nodes, 13 form instances) in compiled 4D 20.8 under Rosetta, measured with diagnostic timers in a disposable host

measurements.beforeIdlePollMs: 1,150-1,450 per exchange; form description 1,070-1,400 of it; JSON serialization of the 337 KB snapshot 7-10; native exchange 53-72
measurements.descriptionBreakdownBefore: control discovery about 120 ms; per-node loop about 900 ms, almost all in one statement assigning the inherited clip collection to each node ($copy.clip:=$clip, about 1.7-1.9 ms per node in subforms)
ruledOut: reading the request object passed through EXECUTE METHOD IN SUBFORM (a local copy of the clip was equally slow)
measurements.pendingTextStepBefore: two descriptions per entered character, 2.54-2.93 s per character
measurements.wholeValueWriteBefore: about 85-character note: 120-second budget exhausted after 46 characters
measurements.wholeValueWriteAfter: 34-39 s for the same note, including line breaks
measurements.voiceOverNotesWorkflowAfter: complete read, edit, save and cancel in 2 min 44 s

changes: Describe the form again after a pending step only when its confirmation produced a final receipt
Store a fresh four-value clip rectangle per described node
